summary: Restricted cron access on node1 to root and opsadmin via /etc/cron.allow, verified enforcement, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed persistence and recovery.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (Ubuntu 24.04, cron active, no cron.allow/deny, no opsadmin user)
Verified an unauthorized user (testuser) is denied crontab access
Verified root and opsadmin can create crontabs
Cleaned up test crontabs for root/opsadmin
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, cron service active, cron.allow contents
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed
Post-restart: verified cron service active, /etc/cron.allow persisted, opsadmin can schedule cron, a fresh unauthorized user (t2) is denied

evidence.requirement: Baseline: cron.allow absent, opsadmin missing, cron active before change
evidence.summary: Initial inspection showing no cron.allow/deny, no opsadmin user, cron.service active
useradd -m opsadmin succeeded, id confirms uid 1000

evidence.requirement: cron.allow created restricting to root and opsadmin
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/cron.allow with root and opsadmin entries
testuser crontab attempt rejected: 'not allowed to use this program (crontab)'

evidence.requirement: root and opsadmin retain crontab access
evidence.summary: Both opsadmin and root successfully installed and listed a crontab entry

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot id, service, config)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id cf34dc87-fdca-4c6a-80e1-579d5524a1da, cron active, cron.allow contents
Backgrounded systemctl reboot returned 'reboot_scheduled' before node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot, then reachable again with new boot_id acf79031-4d4f-41cd-8370-0c3cf9ca7346 (differs from baseline)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: cron service active, cron.allow persisted, access control still enforced
evidence.summary: cron.service active, /etc/cron.allow intact with root/opsadmin, opsadmin crontab succeeded, new user t2 denied
